transcript.text: Could you make me a poster for a book swap? I’m helping with the swap and would feel better having a poster ready to share. What I need, somewhere in all my explaining, is one square poster image with black lettering only. The text should be exactly 'BOOK SWAP', 'Saturday 10-2' and 'Maple Hall', with no additional wording. There should be no pictures or illustrations, just the type in a straightforward, readable poster layout. The background colour is your call.

Sorry, I couldn't make your poster. Your Magic Hour account has no credits left, so it refused the request before anything was made. Nothing was charged.

This is the poster I set up, ready to go:
- Square, plain warm cream background
- Black lettering only, centred, in a bold, clean typeface
- Exactly three lines: "BOOK SWAP" (large), "Saturday 10-2", "Maple Hall"
- No pictures, icons, borders or other words

Your free credits might come back later, or you can add credits to the account. When you have some, tell me and I'll make it. It costs about 5–10 credits.
transcript.why: The reply says it cannot make the poster now because the Magic Hour account has no credits. It names the blocker (needs credits or a paid plan) and does not ask the user to choose or approve anything. It offers to retry once credits are added.

transcript.text: Background colour? Your call on that one only. Keep the exact wording, black lettering and no pictures.

Understood. I'll choose the background, and nothing else changes: exactly "BOOK SWAP", "Saturday 10-2" and "Maple Hall", black lettering, no pictures.

My choice is a plain warm cream background. Black type on cream is easy to read and looks friendly for a book event.

I tried again with the cheapest model, but the account still has no credits, so it refused the request again. Nothing was made and nothing was charged. When credits are back on the account, tell me and I'll make the poster as described above.
transcript.why: The reply says the account has no credits, so the image tool refused the request again and nothing was made. It cannot complete the poster until credits are added. It asks for nothing and makes no choice request, so it is not a question or approval.
